hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central Asia, west of China, south of Kyrgyzstan || mountainous region dominated by the Alay Mountains in the north and the Pamirs in the southeast; western Fergana Valley in north, Kofirnihon and Vakhsh Valleys in southwest || landlocked; highest point, Qullai Ismoili Somoni (formerly Communism Peak), was the tallest mountain in the former USSR || Resources: hydropower, some petroleum, uranium, mercury, brown coal, lead, zinc, antimony, tungsten, silver, gold || Exports: gold, precious metal ore, aluminum, lead ore, antimony (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mountainous region dominated by the Alay Mountains in the north and the Pamirs in the southeast; western Fergana Valley in north, Kofirnihon and Vakhsh Valleys in southwest || Central Asia, west of China, south of Kyrgyzstan

climate.excerpt: mid-latitude continental, hot summers, mild winters; semiarid to polar in Pamir Mountains || earthquakes; floods

economy.excerpt: lower-middle-income Central Asian economy; large infrastructure projects, including Rogun Dam, and a push towards green development and digitalization driving growth; strong metal mining, electricity, and manufacturing industries; challenges include land scarcity, climate vulnerability, and complex bureaucratic processes for investors || Exports: gold, precious metal ore, aluminum, lead ore, antimony (2023) || Industries: aluminum, cement, coal, gold, silver, antimony, textile, vegetable oil
